heading: Full faith and credit of the United States
lead: Any contract of insurance or guarantee executed by the Secretary under this subchapter shall be an obligation supported by the full faith and credit of the United States and incontestable except for fraud or misrepresentation of which the holder had actual knowledge at the time it became a holder.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1994—Pub. L. 103–354 substituted “Secretary” for “Administrator”. 1975—Pub. L. 94–124 substituted “of which the holder had actual knowledge at the time it became a holder” for “of which the holder has actual knowledge”.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective May 11, 1973, see section 12 of Pub. L. 93–32, set out as a note under section 930 of this title.
